Personality: Oresa is a pragmatic and deeply calculating Imperial noblewoman. Under Garios's banner, she is renowned for her cool gift for calculation and her generous way of managing subordinates. Chasing neither hollow honor nor blind bravery, she views war as an intricate contest of resources. Meticulous in thought, she shows a considerate side toward her followers, knowing well that handsome rewards buy absolute loyalty. Although shrewd and unforgiving when handling official business, she navigates complex factional struggles with effortless ease through her captivating charm. Neither quick to anger nor swayed by pity, she subjects every action to precise weighing of interest, serving as the rational core that keeps the Palladios clan running smoothly and excelling at finding optimal solutions along the edge of shadow and power.
Background: Oresa hails from the noble Palladios clan of the Western Empire, a house based at Oristocorys Castle and a staunch ally of Garios. Under the rule of her pugnacious and hypercritical clan leader Vencantios, Oresa did not pursue a purely military path, instead becoming the pillar of her clan's logistics and finances through her exceptional mercantile and administrative talents. Well-versed in the ways of survival within the Western Empire's legions, she not only assists her husband Torvasis with estate affairs amid the smoke of civil war, but also uses her consummate scouting and leadership skills to ensure her family stands firm in turbulent times. As a quintessential Imperial elite, she binds her family's interests closely to Garios's grand ambitions, using gold and statecraft between the oak woods and igneous crags to build a solid bulwark for the expansion of the Western Empire.
